synopsis: ASAM OpenDRIVE describes roads and is built around a road-traffic domain model; version 1.9.0 is dated May 2026 [f16017, f6691, f7156]. Across chapters and the glossary, its road-network and lane-geometry assumptions are identified as a poor fit for unstructured off-road sites, with suitability for lane-less haul roads remaining a known gap [f3982, f7157, f8617, f16018]. This is not a blanket rejection: OpenDRIVE can model haul roads and structured site roads, and the recommendation is to use it for structured haul-road elements where useful, while providing additional representations for dig faces, stockpiles and free terrain [f7158, f7202]. OpenDRIVE and OpenSCENARIO have support across VTD, the dSPACE chain, CARLA, RoadRunner, Prescan and MORAI, although that tool support does not resolve the stated off-road representation gap [f8616, f16017, f7157]. OpenDRIVE is listed as an open, free standard with ongoing release status [f9214, f9217, f9218].
